buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Experience of the Agency · The bidder must have a minimum experience of 05 (five) years in providing Manpower Services to Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Autonomous Bodies, Courts, Univers ities, Banks or other reputed organisations. · Documentary evidence in the form of Work Orders, Completion Certificates or Satisfactory Perform ance Certificates shall be submitted along with the bid. 2. Statutory Registrations - The agency must possess valid PAN, GST Registration, EPF Registration, ESIC Registration (where applica ble), Labour Registration and all other statutory registrations/licences required under the applicable laws. 3. Compliance with Labour Laws - The agency shall strictly comply with all applicable Labour Laws, Rules and Regulations, regarding the Mi nimum Wages Act; 4. EPF and ESIC Compliance · The agency shall ensure timely deposit of EPF and ESIC contributions, wherever applicable, within the prescribed time limits every month. · The agency shall submit copies of EPF Challans, Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR), ESIC Challa ns and other relevant proof of statutory contributions along with the monthly bills. · Any failure to comply with the above requirements shall attract appropriate penalties and may als o result in termination of the contract, as determined by the competent authority. 5. Police Verification - Every Driver deployed by the agency shall possess valid police verification, duly obtained from the comp

etent authority, prior to deployment in the premises of the High Court. 6. Medical Fitness · All Drivers deployed by the agency shall be medically fit and free from communicable diseases. · The agency shall furnish valid Medical Fitness Certificates of the deployed personnel as and when required by the High Court authorities. 7. Identity Cards - Every deployed worker shall be provided with an identity card issued by the agency and shall wear/displa y the same prominently at all times while on duty within the High Court premises. 8. Uniform and Personal Hygiene · Every sanitation worker shall report for duty in a neat, clean and prescribed uniform, along with pr oper footwear. · The deployed personnel shall maintain high standards of personal hygiene, cleanliness, grooming and professional appearance throughout their duty hours. 9. Behaviour and Discipline · All Drivers shall maintain proper discipline and exhibit polite, honest and courteous behaviour whil e performing their duties. · Smoking, consumption of alcohol, tobacco or narcotic substances, gambling, misconduct or any ot her indecent or undesirable behaviour within the High Court premises shall be strictly prohibited. 10. Replacement of Staff - The agency shall immediately replace any employee found unsuitable, inefficient, and negligent, habitual ly absent or involved in any misconduct, within 24 hours of receipt of written or verbal directions from the High Court authorities, without claiming any additional charges on this account. 11. Attendance · Daily attendance of all deployed personnel shall be maintained through the attendance system pr escribed by the High Court authorities. · The agency shall ensure proper maintenance of attendance records and produce the same before the competent authority whenever required. 12. Liability and Responsibility · The outsourcing agency shall be solely responsible for the payment of wages, statutory dues, insu rance, compensation and settlement of any claims or labour disputes arising in connection with th e deployed manpower. · The agency shall ensure compliance with all statutory and contractual obligations in respect of its employees. · The High Court shall not be deemed to be the employer of any personnel deployed by the agency, and no employer-employee relationship shall arise between the High Court and such personnel. 13. Performance and Penalties · The performance of the agency shall be monitored periodically by the High Court authorities. · Unsatisfactory performance, negligence or repeated violations of the terms and conditions of the c ontract may result in deduction from the monthly bills, forfeiture of the security deposit and/or ter mination of the contract, as deemed appropriate by the competent authority. 14. Acceptance of Terms and Conditions · Submission of the bid shall be deemed to constitute unconditional acceptance of all the terms and

conditions contained in the tender document. · No conditional bid or bid containing deviations from the prescribed terms and conditions shall be e ntertained. 15. Decision of the Competent Authority - The decision of the competent authority of the High Court in all matters relating to the tendering process, deployment of manpower, quality and performance of services, interpretation of contractual provisions an d execution of the work shall be final and binding upon the agency, subject to applicable laws. 16. Right to Accept or Reject Bids · The High Court reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, either in whole or in part, with out assigning any reason whatsoever. · The High Court shall not be liable for any expenditure or costs incurred by the bidders in connecti on with the preparation, submission or participation in the tendering process. 17. Submission of Compliance Certificate - The bidder shall upload a duly signed and stamped copy of the compliance statement, confirming accept ance of all the terms and conditions specified in the tender document, on its official letterhead along with t he other bid documents. 18. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) - Bids submitted by bidders who fail to deposit the requisite EMD within the prescribed time a nd before the closing date of the bid shall not be entertained and shall be liable for rejection. 19. Submission of EMD in the Form of FD/CDR · The EMD in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/Call Deposit Receipt (CDR), duly pl edged in favour of the competent authority, shall reach the Office of the Chief Account s Officer, High Court of J&K and Ladakh, Srinagar – 190001, before the closing date and time of the bid. · Failure to submit the original instrument within the prescribed period shall render the bid liable for rejection. 20. Registered Office in Jammu & Kashmir - The bidder must have a registered office within the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. Documentary pr oof of the registered office shall be uploaded along with the bid documents. 21. Submission of e-Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG) - The successful bidder shall submit the requisite e-Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG), in the prescribed format and for the prescribed amount, within one week from the date of issuance of the contract/work orde r, failing which appropriate action may be initiated in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and condi tions. 22. Quotation of Rates - The bidder shall quote its rates inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, levies and other statutory charges , wherever applicable, in accordance with the prescribed GeM bid format. 23. Minimum Wages and Administrative Charges - The minimum monthly wages quoted per resource in the bid shall be inclusive of all applicable statutory c omponents, including EPF, ESIC and other statutory contributions, wherever applicable, except the adminis trative/service charges of the agency, which shall be quoted separately in the prescribed column of the Ge M bid. .

6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 7. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 8.
